value: An IOU names what it is waiting for in a checkable way, so that when that physics lands the IOU reds as STALE instead of reading forever as 'not built yet'.
Does a stale IOU red the COMPONENT (via component_color) or only the inspector run? Redding the component is truer to Law 9 but nine skill charters go red the day it ships.

code-seam@v2 gate set. PROVE GATE: the tester runs proofs beside the code (cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/), teeth a hollow build could not pass, sealed as a VALIDATION — verdict and seal from the same hand. BUILD GATE: the build_inspector's full sieve roster fires at the journaled PROVEME exit through the emit chokepoint; a red there is a finding to dispose, not to argue with. ENTRY GATE: BUILDME refuses without intent_berth, sorted_berth and a berthed validate packet claiming this ticket. EXIT GATE: PROVED refuses without a complete passing verdict artifact answering the claiming validate berth. DURABILITY GATE: not done until proven AND committed (git). KICKS BACK ON: a red proof routes to the point of creation (CP2).
